preconditions.description: Input consists of two integers R and C, each between 1 and 20 inclusive.
Input is a single line with exactly two space-separated integers R and C.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) <= 10**4 and all(c in 'LRUD' for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: Output is a string of length at most 10^4 containing only the characters 'L', 'R', 'U', and 'D'.

postconditions.expression: all((X, Y) != (0, 0) and 1 <= X <= int(R) and 1 <= Y <= int(C) and (X, Y) != (0, 0) for X in range(1, int(R)+1) for Y in range(1, int(C)+1))
postconditions.description: For every possible obstacle position (X, Y) in the grid (1 ≤ X ≤ R, 1 ≤ Y ≤ C), the final position of the robot uniquely identifies (X, Y).

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(final_positions)) == int(R) * int(C) for final_positions in [simulate_robot_movement(seq, X, Y) for X in range(1, int(R)+1) for Y in range(1, int(C)+1)])
postconditions.description: The sequence of instructions produces distinct final positions for every possible obstacle position (X, Y).
